text:
maria: Heads-up — enterprise A and B both asked to onboard different models next quarter. Need a quick take: prioritize low-latency small model (llama-3-mini) for edge customers or high-capacity open model (mistral-8x) for search/rerank workloads? RICE worksheet would help. :thinking:

samir: short answer: depends on who pays and the unit economics. If Dedicated customers request mistral-8x and it drives committed spend, that beats a self-serve win for mini. But we should score both.

lucy: can we do a quick engineering feasibility check first? mistral-8x memory + perf profile is going to need quantization + perf tuning on our runtime. effort likely 3x llama-3-mini.

kai: adding notes from ML side: 
- mistral-8x: better F1 on rerank tests, ~20% lift on our eval set
- llama-3-mini: 2–3x cheaper inference per token, lower latency on low-spec infra

samir: ok quick RICE sketch (ballpark):
```
Model          Reach  Impact  Confidence  Effort  RICE_score
mistral-8x      40     8        0.7       8      = 280
llama-3-mini    60     5        0.8       3      = 800
```
Interpretation: mini has higher RICE mainly due to lower effort and broader reach (self-serve). But mistral has higher impact per request.

maria: that helps. Also consider SLO risk: mistral introduces latency tail risk for Hosted. We need fallback policies to smaller variants or autoscale.

lucy: engineering estimates: 
- llama-3-mini: 2 dev-weeks to add model + 1 week tests + can reuse existing quant path
- mistral-8x: 6 dev-weeks (kernel tuning + quant fallback) + 2 weeks load testing + infra config changes for Dedicated pools

kai: confidence on metrics is medium — our eval set favors mistral for search relevance but product might tolerate smaller wins if cost savings are big.

samir: product tradeoff question: do we prefer higher ARR from Dedicated (sales-led) or faster PLG traction? We should memo the trigger. Suggest: if committed ARR >= $X/month then prioritize mistral onboarding for Dedicated; else schedule llama-3-mini for Hosted self-serve early.

maria: +1 to trigger. Also we should capture launch criteria: 
- latency P50/P95 within target for customer tier
- token cost within 20% of expected forecast
- automated fallback to cheaper model on tail breaches
- docs + SDK examples updated

ops-bot: deploy-bot: bench-run started for `mistral-8x` on staging (job id: 2026-08-451). Will post results. :gear:

lucy: action items: 
1) samir to draft prioritization memo with RICE numbers and the ARR trigger (owner: samir, due: Fri)
2) lucy to confirm engineering estimates and risk log (owner: lucy, due: Tue)
3) kai to extend eval set to include latency-sensitive prompts and rerank slice (owner: kai, due: Wed)
4) ops-bot to attach bench output when ready

maria: one more constraint: roadmap capacity next sprint is 2 FTE-weeks for discovery work. That leans toward llama-3-mini as a low-effort quick win unless sales locks in the Dedicated contract.

samir: sounds good. I'll draft memo and propose the decision matrix: 
- if committed ARR >= $75k/mo -> prioritize mistral-8x (Dedicated path)
- else -> prioritize llama-3-mini (Hosted/PLG) + quick docs + example app

maria: thanks — let's reconvene after bench results and the memo. :eyes:
